vn-ult.name: ULT tube and pipe lasers, two or three chucks, Ø0.4 – 14.2″, 20 – 39 ft bars, 1.5 – 40 kW
vn-ult.summary: The tube laser for round, square, rectangular, oval and open profiles: pneumatic self-centring chucks at both ends of the bar, servo-following supports under it, and a 1.5 to 40 kW source that cuts holes, slots, copes and notches and parts the tube in one pass. Four chuck sizes — Ø6.3″, 9.4″, 11″ and 14.2″ — for bars of 20, 29.5 or 39 ft and up to 2,205 lb; 328 ft/min and 1.2 G on the small chucks. The three-chuck version takes over the bar as it shortens, so the last part is cut with no remnant. Pneumatic loaders, bundle feeding, a ±45° five-axis bevel head and TubesT nesting are options.
